remote.app.allowSaid: devpit asks the person at {machine} before this device pairs.
remote.app.addTitle: Adds this machine's address to devpit.app/remote; nothing else is sent
remote.app.started: Started {name}: it runs in a terminal tab of the project.

remote.relay.signInSaid: devpit.app joins this device to {machine} only when both are signed in to the same account. It passes along what they say and can read none of it.

remote.relay.nothingSaid: On the machine: Settings → Remote, through devpit.app, then Pair a device. Scan the code with this device’s camera. It is good once, for ten minutes.
remote.board.promptCard: What should the session do on this card?

remote.chats.nobody: No orchestrator, session or chat to talk to yet.

remote.pair.allow: Allow this device on the machine: devpit asks there before it pairs.
remote.secret.watchOnly: This device may only watch. Allow it to type on the machine to keep a secret from here.

remote.secret.kept: Kept in the project’s .env, readable by you alone and kept out of git. Paste a key here, never in a chat.
